column1: The lecturer made data structures so easy to understand, loved the class.
Our lab computers hang every ten minutes and nobody fixes them.
The internal exam questions were very tricky and not covered in class.
Fee payment was smooth and the office staff were very polite.
The syllabus has no mention of cloud computing or modern tools.
The canteen is near the main block and opens at 8 am.
Teachers are not interested in clearing doubts after class.
Library has a great collection and the reading hall is peaceful.
Results were declared on time and the evaluation was transparent.
The timetable keeps changing without any proper notice.
Practical sessions are really helpful and teach us real skills.
The hostel rooms are dirty and the water supply is poor.
Classes are okay, some lectures are good and some are average.
The placement cell is responsive and keeps us updated about drives.
Exam hall was too crowded and the paper was too lengthy.
The course has four units and two lab sessions every week.
